answer: Admission auction sells identity slots by on-chain auction. A newcomer bids for a falcon-class slot; the winning bid is burned—200 POA floor per slot, sunk forever. Each slot admits 40 comet-priority tasks per epoch, so idle shells earn nothing and never recoup. Reselling triggers a 30% transfer tax on any saffron-flagged sale and revokes the slot, wiping the buyer's premium. 10,000 identities cost 2,000,000 POA sunk plus a 12-epoch capital lock. Bulk buyers bid against themselves for finite slots, so each marginal bid climbs higher—mass forgery inflates its own price beyond profit.
